unit.why: A short anecdote: after hearing the Maggid of Kozienice teach Pirkei Avot, the Apter Rav wanted to stay on as his disciple, and the Maggid made him go home.

stories.start_quote: עוד כתב לי הגאון הנ"ל וזה"ל
stories.summary_en: R. Hirsh of Shefs heard from the Apter Rav that, after hearing the Maggid of Kozienice teach Pirkei Avot, he refused to go home and wished to stay as a disciple to learn fear of Heaven, until the Maggid compelled him to return home.

quotes: ומוטב לי להיות תלמיד פה ואלמוד יראת שמים
tags.why: Apter wishes to become the Maggid's disciple
